plot.title: Web of Finance
plot.setup: Spider-Man needs to save up for a new web-shooter upgrade while fighting the Vulture, whose latest scheme involves stealing valuable tech from Stark Industries, ironically.
plot.location: A bustling street corner in Queens, New York, near a brightly colored comic book store named 'Stark Raving Mad Comics,' with a Chase Bank branch visible across the street.

dialogue.text: Kid, your web-shooters are like my arc reactor – essential! But even Stark Unlimited has a budget. Think of your income as your reactor's power output. You need to allocate it wisely: some for essentials (fighting bad guys!), some for upgrades (new web fluid!), and some for… well, not buying every limited-edition comic book that comes out.
dialogue.hint: Explain budgeting by comparing the Avengers team budget, where each hero's needs are prioritized.

dialogue.text: Hey, loser, heard you're finally trying to be responsible. Big whoop. But seriously, everyone's going to that new Hawkins-themed escape room this weekend. It's gonna cost, like, $50 per person. You in... or are you gonna be too busy scrimping and saving?
dialogue.hint: MJ presents a common peer pressure scenario of spending money on social activities versus saving for a goal.

dialogue.text: Ugh, MJ, you know I wanna go! But Vulture's been extra busy, and I kinda REALLY need those impact webs… Plus, that escape room will probably be booked solid by the time I can even decide. Maybe I can swing by the comic store for free comic book day later.
dialogue.hint: Spider-Man expresses internal conflict between wanting to spend and needing to save.

characters.name: Spider-Man
characters.description: Peter Parker in his classic red and blue Spider-Man suit, but slightly worn and patched in places. He looks stressed, with furrowed brows visible even under the mask. He's perched on a lamppost, looking down at the street with concern.

characters.name: Iron Man
characters.description: Tony Stark in his sleek, red and gold Iron Man suit, but with some visible scratches and dents from recent battles. He's hovering in the air, gesturing with his hand, a holographic projection of a pie chart showing Spider-Man's 'Finances'.

characters.name: MJ
characters.description: Michelle Jones (MJ) wearing a sarcastic t-shirt with the words 'Reality Bites' on it. She's leaning against a brick wall, arms crossed, looking impatient and slightly amused. She has her signature deadpan expression and a slightly messy bun.

backgrounds.name: Main location
backgrounds.description: A vibrant, bustling street corner in Queens, New York. The comic book store 'Stark Raving Mad Comics' is brightly colored and eye-catching. The Chase Bank branch across the street is modern and professional-looking. People are walking by, some dressed in superhero-themed clothing.

backgrounds.name: Secondary location
backgrounds.description: A dimly lit rooftop overlooking the city, with the Avengers Tower visible in the distance. Spider-Man is perched on the edge, looking out at the skyline. Rain is gently falling, creating a reflective surface on the rooftops.

visuals.financial_elements: A holographic pie chart projected by Iron Man's armor visualizing Spider-Man's budget. The chart is divided into segments: 'Web Fluid' (largest), 'Rent' (second largest), 'Food' (medium), 'Comics' (smallest), and 'Emergency Funds' (a tiny sliver).

hooks.pop_culture: Stranger Things reference: MJ mentioning the Hawkins-themed escape room and its cost.
hooks.music: Anti-Hero By Taylor Swift theme: The underlying theme of struggling with responsibility and internal conflict is reflected in the song's message.
